# Status Effects

- **Slow**: monsters lose 50% of their speed, players 40%
- **Poison, Burning, Bleeding**: 5 HP lost every 1 s unless the attack says otherwise
- **Darkness** and **Weaken**: 30% and 30% less damage dealt
- **Curse**: 50% less EXP gained
- **Seal**: no skills
- Stun and freeze on a boss last 50% of their time
